location: Typed FieldBinding.metadata, owned by that Field definition

members.usePointer: Utf8 absolute JSON pointer to this FieldBinding's /field/resource
members.bytes: BytesRef to the actual logical resource in the engine capture
members.descriptorDigest: Utf8 SHA-256 of canonical FS1 Field descriptor

identity: Each active field has one associated use. Equal digests do not merge distinct logical resources.
installedUse: The native installer reserves field-data/<field ordinal>/<owner kind>/<owner ordinal> in its resource table. These logical keys survive fresh IDs and are independent of the metadata BytesRef. The reader requires a bijection between slots and typed uses.
validation: Compare the installed slot and exact logical Resource ID, then owner, encoding, descriptor, immutable scoped bytes and storage shape/closure before activation. An editable phase cannot silently change the basis of one of its periodic Fields.
